g.text: Val Chmerkovskiy Says He Wants ‘Nothing But Love’ for Carrie Ann Inaba Following ‘DWTS’ Suspension, Apologizes to Jenna Dewan: ‘I Am So Sorry for All the C ◆ Amy Poehler Tells Noah Wyle ‘The Pitt’ Needs More Romance: If You’re ‘Gonna Show the Guts, You Gotta Show Some Butts’ ◆ Melanie Lynskey to Play Erin Patterson in ‘Mushroom Murders’ Limited Series at Paramount+ ◆ Variety Nominated for 62 Arts & Entertainment Journalism Awards ◆ ‘Reacher,’ ‘Neagley,’ ‘Lioness’ Give Paramount TV Studios Three of September’s Four Most-Streamed Original Series ◆ Politico Plans Live Video Coverage of Midterm Elections ◆
